fields.description: Off until a human turns it on. A rule set that exists is not a rule set that runs.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The Employee field holding the grade that the rates below are keyed on. For DTC this is dtc_grade.
fields.label: Grade Field On Employee

fields.description: The Employee field saying whether special-day deductions are doubled for this person. A value of Yes or 1 means doubled. For DTC this is dtc_double_deduction. Leave blank to double for everybody.
fields.label: Double Deduction Field On Employee

fields.description: The Employee field saying which marks this person can earn. Blank or Morning Green or Both allows a morning green; Night Green or Both allows a night green. For DTC this is dtc_green_eligibility. Leave blank and everyone earns both.
fields.label: Green Eligibility Field On Employee

fields.description: Arriving within this many minutes of shift start counts as on time.
fields.label: Grace Minutes

fields.description: Reds up to this count cost nothing. Only those beyond it are deducted.
fields.label: Free Reds Per Month

fields.description: Quarter deductions are multiplied by this on a special day. Red marks are never multiplied.
fields.label: Special Day Multiplier

fields.description: A marker list of high-footfall days. It must NOT be set as anyone's holiday list - that would make these days non-working, which is the opposite of the rule.
fields.label: Special Day List

fields.description: Checking in inside this window costs extra quarters, for flagged employees only. Leave blank to switch the rule off.
fields.label: From

fields.description: Added on top of whatever the slab already gave. It penalises the window of arrival, not the minutes missed, which is why it does not double-charge.
fields.label: Extra Quarters

fields.description: The Employee check field that flags who this applies to. For DTC this is dtc_11am_quarter_deduction.
fields.label: Employee Flag Field

fields.description: Attendance percentage to quarters off and red marks. Rows must cover 0 to 100 without gaps or overlaps - the rule set refuses to save otherwise.
fields.label: Slabs

fields.description: What one red or one green is worth, per grade.
fields.label: Mark Rates

fields.description: The Employee field holding the leave class the accrual rates below are keyed on. For DTC this is dtc_leave_class.
fields.label: Leave Class Field On Employee

fields.description: The Employee field holding the category the overrides below are keyed on. For DTC this is employment_type, a standard ERPNext field that was sitting unused.
fields.label: Category Field On Employee

fields.description: Days present in the month before the leave class is credited. Below it the employee is paid for the days they worked and nothing else. Nothing is pro-rated either side of the line.
fields.label: Leave Threshold (Days Present)

fields.description: What a full month is worth per class, credited whole once the threshold is reached.
fields.label: Leave Classes

fields.description: Only for staff whose category earns no leave credit. The class figure caps every row.
fields.label: Leave Earned by Days Present (by Designation)

fields.description: Per-category exceptions to the rules above. A category not listed here takes the defaults: the standard grace, marks on, leave credits on.
fields.label: Categories

fields.description: The policy calendar for the accrual, which is NOT the real length of the month. At 30, a 31-day month closes no extra period.
fields.label: Accrual Month Days
